notes.title: Paint by Pixel 2 - NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
"Paint by Pixel 2" has officially arrived on Steam today!

Get ready to explore the wonderful realm of pixel art and unleash your imagination! Whether you're an experienced artist or a budding creator, this game is tailor-made for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44029630/8811c8c8dde3f736d83fc721c79a8f63cbae70b3.gif[/img]

With its user-friendly controls and intuitive gameplay, Paint by Pixel 2 offers a delightful experience for players of all skill levels. Lose yourself in the process as you bring beautiful pixel paintings to life, one pixel at a time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44029630/6a09cadc5c9373fda7cfcec378a57cbb7f94067c.gif[/img]

Embrace the joy of artistic expression and embark on a pixelated adventure like no other. Immerse yourself in the world of Paint by Pixel 2 and let your imagination soar!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408610/Paint_by_Pixel_2/

notes.title: Paint by Pixel - Now Available!
notes.content:
Paint by Pixel is NOW AVAILABLE on Steam! This relaxing puzzle game allows you to create beautiful works of art, one pixel at a time. With 95 levels to choose from, there's no shortage of artistic challenges to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841376/93d7643d26a42b04a251c08b4b255bddf871d6a9.gif[/img]

In Paint by Pixel, you can choose between brush or fill mode, recolor your drawings to personalize them, and use zoom and the magnifying glass to focus on details. The game also includes an autofill feature and hints to make things easier, so you can focus on the joy of creating art.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841376/8a1f09169eb8c4ef4dafaf60d4bfde1ac7eaa96f.gif[/img]

If you're looking for a relaxing and engaging way to explore your artistic side, Paint by Pixel is the perfect game for you. Get your copy on Steam today and start creating your masterpiece!
